name: Headliner
tagline: The core loop is buildable, but a dependable replacement becomes a real weekend or multi-day project. For Headliner, create captioned audiograms and short social clips from user-owned audio. The hard boundary is rendering infrastructure, templates, media hosting, and platform-specific presets, plus audio infrastructure, distribution, and production polish.
